paragraphs: Yitzḥak of the house of R. Yannai (see above).

Since there is an undesignated R. Yitzḥak of halakhic teachings and an undesignated R. Yitzḥak of aggadah, as above, and there is an undesignated R. Yitzḥak who is a tanna of a baraita, you must therefore understand and discern.

Abba bar Zemina, in his name. R. Abba bar Adda, in his name. R. Avin bar Adda, in his name. R. Adda bar Aḥa, in his name. Rav Aḥa bar Avira, in his name. R. Aḥa bar Rav Ketina said: R. Yitzḥak said. R. Aḥa bar Adda, in his name. R. Immi. R. Aloni bar Tavri, in his name. It is taught: R. Yitzḥak, in R. Elazar's name, beginning of chapter Mi SheHeḥshikh (I do not know who this R. Yitzḥak and R. Elazar are). R. Ammi bar Abba, in his name. And R. Burki. R. Binyamin bar Yefet and R. Ba debated before him. R. Binyamin bar Levi reported [a discussion involving] R. Yitzḥak. R. Berekhya, in his name. Bata. Rav Huna bar Ketina said: R. Yitzḥak said. Rav Huna bar Yehudah said: R. Yitzḥak said. Ḥizkiyah and Yehudah, R. Ḥiyya's sons, in his name. Rav Ḥisda said: R. Yitzḥak said, Sukkah (44b); and he was present at Rav Ḥisda's burial. Rabbi sent [a message] through R. Yitzḥak and R. Natan to R. Ḥananyah, the son of R. Yehoshua’s brother (see his entry). Bar Tavri asked him. In R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter HeArel, halakhah 1. R. Yehoshua bar Neḥemyah, in his name. He said, 'R. Yoḥanan said,' Berakhot (4b, 10b), Ta'anit (35a as printed; compare 5a), several expositions; Zevaḥim (43b). R. Yaakov bar Avina expounded before him. R. Yitzḥak Seḥora asked him. He called Rav Kahana 'my teacher,' Rosh HaShanah (4a). R. Levi Tzinberayya asked him. Mari bar Abbahu said: R. Yitzḥak said. He blessed Rav Naḥman (see his entry). R. Naḥman said: R. Yitzḥak said, Berakhot (7, end of side b). In R. Natan's name. R. Amram, in his name. Rava said, 'I learned it from him,' Megillah (10a); and in his name, Berakhot (32a). Rami bar Abba, in his name. Rami bar Ḥama said: R. Yitzḥak said, Avodah Zarah (31b), Yevamot (39b). In the name of Shemuel bar Marta. He said, 'Resh Lakish said,' Menaḥot (5b), Avodah Zarah (14a). Shimon Nezira, in his name. Rav Sheshet said: 'Go and tell R. Yitzḥak: Rav Huna has already interpreted your teaching in Babylonia,' chapter Kirah (43b).
